about_the_game:
A wish-granting chance for everyone—young and old alike! The Wish Pot Festival has begun.

Players choose one character from Korea’s classic folktales and enter the Wish Pot Tournament hosted by Dangun. Wish Pot is a board game-style showdown.

Each player places tiles into their own pot—tiles marked with numbers and special ability symbols—shuffles them, then draws them in secret. From the tiles you draw, you can combine two to decide how to attack your opponent, and how strong your attack will be. As you progress, you can also learn new skills to unleash even greater power.

After choosing your attack skill, the match moves into a territory-grabbing phase: the familiar “land-claiming” game you already know. Decide how far to throw your flag—the farther you throw, the harder it is to retrieve!

If your thrown flag clashes with an opponent’s, you settle it with combat using the attack skill you prepared. If the showdown feels too risky, running away first is also a valid option.

The winner claims land equal to the distance of their thrown flag.

The tournament runs from qualifiers all the way to the finals. After every match, you use the rewards you earned to swap out the tiles in your pot and strengthen your deck. Add new ability symbols, replace the numbers themselves to gain probabilistic advantage, and upgrade tiles to aim for higher attack power. Build your deck and design victory through strategy—not just luck.

On top of that, you’ll face Missions that require specific actions during a match, and receive sponsor Gifts—like being the star of an e-sports event—bringing in more resources to build an even stronger deck.

Bring Talismans for powerful effects, and use the Read system to peek into your opponent’s tiles, pushing you one step closer to victory.

This is a single-player PC game—a deckbuilding, strategy-driven territory-claiming battle game.

With simple rules at its core, Wish Pot delivers constant tension, meaningful decisions, and the thrill of deep strategic play.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Unreal Engine 5 title
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit (or Windows 10 64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6600 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Unreal Engine 5 title

short_description: Korean folklore comes to life in a strategic board game where you chase your wishes! Combine number-and-ability cards to battle, upgrade your deck, and claim territory. Every match feels fresh—and tense—thanks to missions, talismans, sponsorships, and the Read system!
